templates.why_chosen: High-confidence layered background exemplar at floor size, 8 components and 3 flows, stacking host, PCIe band, hardware package and network fabric tiers, with one labelled DMA arrow crossing the boundary.
templates.what_to_learn: For a hardware-background figure, draw the bus itself as a distinct shaded band between tiers rather than an arrow, and add only the one cross-boundary arrow the text actually needs instead of wiring every block to every other block.

templates.why_chosen: A minimal floorplan nested in a background stack figure: the BlueField-3 boundary places DPA compute next to its own NIC DRAM and a separate off-path ARM control core, with one DMA arrow crossing PCIe above.
templates.what_to_learn: Even a small background/context figure can carry a mini floorplan: place a chip's compute (DPA) directly beside the memory it actually touches (NIC DRAM), keep the separate off-path control core (ARM) at arm's length, and mark the one crossing that matters, direct host DMA, with a single labeled arrow.
